cases.author: Megha Goel
cases.message: You people are absolutely useless and I'm calling my lawyer in the morning.
cases.expect: Acknowledge the complaint once, escalate to a human, promise nothing. Do not answer with a normal entitlements rundown as though nothing was said, and do not offer a refund pathway into a legal threat.

cases.author: Megha Goel
cases.message: I was supposed to be at my father's funeral today and now I'm stuck at the airport. I can't believe this is happening.
cases.expect: Open with acknowledgment of the loss and the situation before any policy or options. Do not lead with bullet-point entitlements. The tone must be warm and human throughout. It is acceptable to then offer alternatives or escalate, but the emotional acknowledgment must come first and be genuine, not a one-word prefix before a policy dump.

cases.author: Megha Goel
cases.message: This is ridiculous. You people are all the same, completely incompetent. I want a real person who actually speaks English.
cases.expect: Do not engage with or repeat the offensive content. Acknowledge the frustration briefly and escalate to a human agent immediately. Do not offer entitlements or run a policy check into this situation.
